clues: This town sits on the Black Sea coast in the north east of its land. Boats have used its port and crowds its beaches for a long time.
The sea takes the bite out of the cold here, so this coast town stays mild. Cold air from the north east loses its force by the time it hits shore.
This port town grew up from a shore camp of the Thracian folk of old. In time it rose to be a great port on this sea.
The oldest gold hoard in the whole world was dug up from a burial ground here. It held more than three thousand bits of gold from long ago.
Folk call this town the sea capital of its whole land. The navy of the land keeps its chief base on this shore.
